# PagerPilot

> PagerPilot is an AI on-call engineer. It takes first response on every production alert, investigates across your logs, metrics, traces, and recent deploys, and hands your team a root cause and a proposed fix — so 3am pages become morning summaries.

## What PagerPilot is
- An AI on-call / SRE engineer for software teams.
- Takes first response on alerts, triages noise, does root-cause analysis, proposes fixes.
- Read-only by default; a graduated "autonomy ladder" earns its way toward guarded remediation.
- Connects to existing tools (Datadog, Grafana, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Kubernetes, GitHub) — no rip-and-replace, no agents or sidecars.

## Who it is for
- B2B SaaS / cloud-native teams, roughly Series A–C, 15–150 engineers.
- Teams with a rotating on-call but no dedicated SRE org, facing alert fatigue and on-call burnout.
- Buyer: VP/Head of Engineering, or first platform/infra hire.

## How it is different
- Built for teams without an SRE army: fast setup, mid-market pricing (vs. enterprise-first Resolve.ai, Traversal, Cleric).
- Trust ladder starting read-only (vs. all-at-once autonomy claims or human-in-the-loop-forever tools).
- Optimizes for signal (pages that never wake a human) and burnout, not just MTTR.

## Key facts
- Your production data is never used to train models.
- Least-privilege, read-only access by default, with full audit logging.
- Currently onboarding founding design partners (early access).

## Contact / next step
- Book a demo from the site to see PagerPilot on your own incidents.
